results.title: La casa
results.overview: After many years working for a multinational company, Hugo Vaca is laid off and must face the harsh reality of the job market. On the verge of despair, he connects through a friend with a group of investors who offer to buy his house, valued at one million dollars, at 50 percent of its value, but with usufruct rights until his death. Cornered by reality, he accepts the deal, but things end up becoming much more complicated than he expected.

results.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
results.overview: A talented shrimp chef with an ego that outweighs his tiny body carries out his vendetta against a certain culinary inclined rat which puts The Shrimp’s human puppet at risk of deportation.

results.title: Oye Bhole Oye 2
results.overview: A simple village boy refuses to sell his land when a powerful company offers big money, even as his own family gives in. As he stands alone, his fight turns from a personal struggle into a larger battle to protect his roots and expose the truth behind the project.

results.title: The Victorians
results.overview: In the gritty underbelly of Amsterdam, a band of rogues scheme against one another as they prey on unsuspecting tourists. While Abba fights his obsession with the sadist Danny, his romantically naive brother, Rey, falls for the femme fatale, Faith. Masquerading as a tour guide, Danny enjoys luring tourists into his sadistic web, while Virgil, the deviant hotel owner, is there to help pick up the pieces. Alfi, the devious junkie, remains Abba's faithful liege, but the worm might turn if promises of taking him to Spain go unfulfilled. The fragile balance of their alliance falls apart when a cocky American enters the fray.

results.title: Million Dollar Guy
results.overview: After winning 12 million euros in the lottery, Andi turns his life upside down and buys everything he's ever wanted. But as he gains power and success, he starts to lose the things money can't buy.

results.title: The Plastic Men
results.overview: Vietnam veteran Jonathan Teller suffers from guilt and paranoid delusions. He decides to take his own life, but as he struggles to come to terms with his choice and reality, a chance encounter changes everything.

results.title: Burrow
results.overview: A year after the death of her brother, a young woman joins her friends on a drug-infused getaway that spirals into a night of horror when an alien insect burrows into one of her friends, transforming him into a vicious man-eating creature.

results.title: Mr. Ankles
results.overview: Short film screened at Chicago Horror Film Festival 2025.

results.title: Becoming Hines Ward
results.overview: From Super Bowl MVP to a man searching for peace, this is the untold story of Hines Ward—whose journey is defined not by touchdowns, but by identity. The son of a Korean mother and an American soldier, Ward grew up caught between worlds, never fully accepted by either. Football made him a legend, but couldn’t quiet the questions: Who am I? Where do I belong?  Decades later, Ward returns to South Korea with his family to confront the culture he once resented and the sacrifices his mother made. What begins as a personal pilgrimage becomes a reckoning with history and a mission to change the lives of children who now walk the path he once did.

results.title: Kungaparets guldbröllop - intervju
results.overview: Pernilla Månsson Colt meets the royal couple on Öland in a personal interview ahead of the celebration of their golden wedding.

results.title: Alma
results.overview: A filmmaker imagines his wife’s death as a mysterious disappearance in the Swiss Alps, casting his real family in an experimental exploration of grief and the search for closure.

results.title: Love Finds You
results.overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

results.title: Quando Tudo Joga Contra
results.overview: On the verge of failing literature, a high school soccer defender begins tutoring sessions with the quiet boy in his class—unaware that their connection will turn into something more.

results.title: Parasites
results.overview: When two families vacation in paradise, an alien parasite crashes into their world, infecting the locals and unleashing chaos. As reality unravels, survival means facing what's inside - and what's coming. For fans of 'A Quiet Place'.

results.title: Retrograde Battlefield
results.overview: It centers on a Chinese People's Volunteer Army unit during a past conflict that, despite orders to retreat, embarks on a dangerous mission to re-enter the battlefield and fight to protect their homeland

results.title: Gangster’s Daughter 4
results.overview: Kadisha Spencer continues to run her father’s brutal empire while matching wits with Detective Steel and meticulously eliminating her enemies.

results.title: Surrender To It
results.overview: Chaos ensues when a grieving father reunites with his old actor friends on a mysterious weekend in the UK's wild west.

results.title: The Wolf
results.overview: Yuan, a 60 year old former village mayor in Shanghai, seeks freedom through heartbreak, marriage and LGBTQ+ repression in modern China.  Known as "Wolf," Yuan is a mother, business owner and lesbian who remains married while caring for her aging husband. Her life has been shaped by compromise at every turn, her identity negotiated within rigid family and societal expectations. Now, with her daughter grown, she is finally claiming space for herself and a new relationship with a woman thirty years her junior. But in a country where personal desire and duty are rarely allowed to coexist, nothing stays simple for long. Shot on iPhone with striking observational intimacy, The Wolf weaves past and present into a compelling portrait of a woman who has spent decades navigating the gap between the life she was given and the one she wants.

results.title: Margeado
results.overview: The river is not the same. It has turned into contaminated mud. Residents of a fishing village face an uncertain future after the dam burst. Yara and Dingue resume their lives, remain and drift in the memory of the place while the waters run down the mountains in the face of the indomitable forces of nature.
